title: Conversation changes and finds a fit
meaning: Clear words help you respond to change and find a compatible form of participation that preserves the importance of both people’s possibilities.
text: A new turn in plans may require a different wording of a promise. The Emperor in the physical position of Vishuddha helps state terms clearly: what changed, which replies are still needed and what you now accept. The Wheel of Fortune in energy supports readiness to consider the changed situation and find a suitable conversational move. Temperance in emotions responds with coordination. Different possibilities begin to fit within one decision. It can feel easier when words accurately express both people’s current involvement, allowing each person room beyond an earlier form.

For example, only half an hour becomes available instead of a promised long conversation. You clarify which question needs discussion today and what can wait until another evening. **A changed promise can preserve participation by both people.** One needs company with the subject; the other needs freedom from promising unavailable time. Clear words connect those needs and give the exchange a realistic extent.

The difficulty starts if that calm sense of coordination lets an unfinished part pass unnoticed. You seem to have adapted well, but nobody names when the rest will receive attention. Considering circumstances remains useful. A clear word about continuation helps a temporary form avoid becoming an indefinite postponement of something both people wanted to discuss.
